speaker: Doctor

The normal sweat chloride test rules out cystic fibrosis and meconium ileus, leaving ileal atresia as the most likely diagnosis given the failure to pass meconium and bilious vomiting. I have exhausted my diagnostic options and am confident in this assessment.
